model: TUDOR Black Bay Chrono M79360N-0013 (41 mm steel, black dial, black tachymeter bezel, steel five-column bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Black Bay Chrono template (config/watches/tudor-bbchrono-*, pipeline/steps/watch_tudor_bbchrono.py): case, tachymeter bezel (polished flange + black insert + thin steel rim), fluted crown on a neck, two angled chronograph pushers, hour hand as a free polygon, minute sword, central chronograph seconds hand (triangle tail, ball tip), two sub-dial hands with hubs, five-column bracelet from the 41 mm photo; the black dial with both sub-dials, print, date window and minute track comes from one 2x photo map with the photographed hands left in it.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug top edge y 300 px, bottom y 945 px); top slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: steel ring: polished flange (bezel_in, 1.32 mm wide, sloping up to the insert) + black tachymeter insert (to insert_out) + thin steel rim (to bezel_out); numerals, pearls and ticks come from the projected photo

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, 0.04 mm wider than the photographed hands so the 3D hands hide the ones in the map; the last point sits at the traced length. Hour hand, the two sub-dial hands and the seconds-hand triangle lume are free polygons (hands.polygons, mm about the pivot, x right, y toward 12). Hands, hubs and discs use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: fluted crown x 731..771 px (radius 3.81 mm, centre y -0.73 mm), neck from the bezel (83 px high); the photo shows about 22 flutes, 40 teeth keep it round

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind

bracelet.note: Flat five-column bracelet (outer, inner, centre, inner, outer; 13.6585 px/mm, pivot (449, 612)). Joints read from the photo (mean luminance along each column band, 4x crops), top / bottom separately; outer joints top y 300 (case edge) / 232 / 175, bottom 945 / 1023 / 1087; inner top 311 / 258 / 196 / 156, bottom 989 / 1052 / 1102 (double dark lines 262..270 and 1046..1058 are in the projected photo); centre top 300.5 / 231 / 174, bottom 1023 / 1086.5. Bracelet alpha ends y 142 (top) / 1122 (bottom). Vertical joint lines top x 384 / 428 / 470 / 515, bottom 383 / 428 / 469 / 513.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

pushers.note: two chronograph pushers at 2 and 4 o'clock measured from the photo: axis radial from (449, 622) px at +-30 deg; smooth base tube r 37 px up to 287 px, fluted ring r 40 px (2.93 mm) 287..315 px, smooth cap cylinder r 27 px to the end face at 341.5 px (all from the axis origin); steel_photo texture
